Panel on 'One Nation, One Election' gets report extension

The parliamentary committee examining the 'One Nation, One Election' proposal has been granted an extension. The committee will now submit its report by the upcoming Winter Session of Parliament. This panel was formed to study the feasibility of holding simultaneous elections across the country.
